_note: V4.7b's break-up verb. The split is pro-rata among the sector's OTHER MAJORS -- its rivals divide the market (the first draft split to the body tier and the pin caught it: pro-rata receipts push body firms past BODY_SHARE_MAX, the escalation the tier boundary exists to make impossible). A sector whose only major is the target refuses the verb: no absorber means the split silently falls to the residual -- a sector lever wearing a firm's name. The major's headcount reads zero through the committed flag, and its market share moves with the rivals' live ratios.

actions.name: Break Up the Firm
actions.summary: Competition law dissolves the champion. Its market share passes to its rivals; its payroll goes with it; it does not come back.
